sections.title: A desk that sells, not a desk that writes
sections.body: A member walks in to renew, a visitor wants a day pass, a regular buys a class pack. Each one is a few taps at the desk with a receipt on WhatsApp or paper, and each sale lands in your books with nothing to re-key. The starter catalogue comes with memberships, passes, classes and personal training already set up for you to edit.
items: Every sale in the books automatically

sections.title: Know your members and bring them back
sections.body: See who bought what and when, bill monthly memberships with recurring invoices, and reward regulars with loyalty points they can spend at the desk. Built in Oman with native OMR and 5% VAT, and ready for any currency or tax rate.

faqs.q: Does it work for yoga and Pilates studios too?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose the Yoga & Pilates pack at signup and you start with drop-in classes, class passes and monthly unlimited memberships. Choose Gym & Fitness for memberships, day passes and personal training.

faqs.q: Can I bill memberships every month?
faqs.a: Yes. Use recurring invoices to bill a membership on a schedule, then record the payment when it comes in.

faqs.q: Can I sell at the front desk?
faqs.a: Yes. The POS module lets you sell passes, classes and products at the desk and hand over a receipt.
Yes. The Loyalty module gives members points on purchases that they can spend later.
Sales and Invoicing is free forever. Add CRM, POS or Loyalty when you need them and pay only for those modules.

ctaTitle: Run your gym or studio without the paperwork
ctaSub: Start free with invoices and receipts, then add the front desk, member list and loyalty when you need them.
